title: Accountability Data Guide FY22
retrieval: Complete official PDF web-reader text: 6 pages, 254 lines; original PDF bytes not archived
paraphrase: Reports include separate aggregate rows for All and demographic groups. Counts of ten or fewer and complementary revealing cells are suppressed. Very high and low percentages are displayed as greater-than98 or less-than2. The guide warns that similarly named federal and state measures can differ. It supplies no observed duplicate budget and does not resolve the FY2025 PXU cross-level cohort discrepancy.
scope: Historical FY22 reporting guide, not a claim of current FY2025 product implementation
